SELECT 'task' AS entity_type, CONCAT('task:', l.id) AS id, l.id AS sort_id, l.created_at AS at, l.task_id AS entity_id, t.title AS entity_title, t.req_id AS project_id, r.name AS project_name, l.action AS action, l.detail AS detail, l.actor_id AS actor_id, u.display_name AS actor_name FROM task_log l LEFT JOIN task t ON t.id = l.task_id AND t.workspace_id = l.workspace_id LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = t.req_id AND r.workspace_id = l.workspace_id LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = l.actor_id WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND l.task_id != 'CFG'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'project' AS entity_type, CONCAT('project:', a.id) AS id, a.id AS sort_id, a.created_at AS at, a.entity_id AS entity_id, r.name AS entity_title, r.id AS project_id, r.name AS project_name, a.action AS action, a.detail AS detail, a.actor_id AS actor_id, a.actor_name AS actor_name FROM work_activity a INNER JOIN requirement r ON r.id = a.entity_id AND r.workspace_id = a.workspace_id WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND a.entity_type = 'project'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'doc' AS entity_type, CONCAT('doc:', a.id) AS id, a.id AS sort_id, a.created_at AS at, a.entity_id AS entity_id, d.title AS entity_title, d.req_id AS project_id, r.name AS project_name, a.action AS action, a.detail AS detail, a.actor_id AS actor_id, a.actor_name AS actor_name FROM work_activity a INNER JOIN requirement_doc d ON d.id = a.entity_id AND d.workspace_id = a.workspace_id LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = d.req_id AND r.workspace_id = a.workspace_id WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND a.entity_type = 'requirement_doc'
AND (d.published_at IS NOT NULL OR d.owner_user_id = #{userId})
UNION ALL
SELECT 'demand' AS entity_type, CONCAT('demand:', dl.id) AS id, dl.id AS sort_id, dl.created_at AS at, dl.demand_id AS entity_id, d.title AS entity_title, d.req_id AS project_id, r.name AS project_name, dl.action AS action, dl.note AS detail, dl.operator AS actor_id, u.display_name AS actor_name FROM demand_log dl INNER JOIN demand d ON d.id = dl.demand_id AND d.workspace_id = dl.workspace_id LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = d.req_id AND r.workspace_id = dl.workspace_id LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = dl.operator WHERE dl.workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
UNION ALL
SELECT 'branch' AS entity_type, CONCAT('branch:', bl.id) AS id, 0 AS sort_id, bl.created_at AS at, bl.branch_id AS entity_id, b.name AS entity_title, b.req_id AS project_id, r.name AS project_name, bl.action AS action, bl.detail AS detail, bl.actor_user_id AS actor_id, bl.actor_name AS actor_name FROM dev_branch_log bl INNER JOIN dev_branch b ON b.id = bl.branch_id AND b.workspace_id = bl.workspace_id LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = b.req_id AND r.workspace_id = bl.workspace_id WHERE bl.workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
UNION ALL
SELECT 'version' AS entity_type, CONCAT('version:', vl.id) AS id, vl.id AS sort_id, vl.created_at AS at, vl.version_id AS entity_id, v.name AS entity_title, v.req_id AS project_id, r.name AS project_name, vl.action AS action, vl.reason AS detail, vl.actor_id AS actor_id, u.display_name AS actor_name FROM version_log vl INNER JOIN project_version v ON v.id = vl.version_id AND v.workspace_id = vl.workspace_id LEFT JOIN requirement r ON r.id = v.req_id AND r.workspace_id = vl.workspace_id LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = vl.actor_id WHERE vl.workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
UNION ALL SELECT 'config' AS entity_type, CONCAT('config:', l.id) AS id, l.id AS sort_id, l.created_at AS at, l.task_id AS entity_id, NULL AS entity_title, NULL AS project_id, NULL AS project_name, l.action AS action, l.detail AS detail, l.actor_id AS actor_id, u.display_name AS actor_name FROM task_log l LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = l.actor_id WHERE l.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND l.task_id = 'CFG'
